assertion_independence: No assertion merely echoes an injected result: parsing is checked against independently required grammar structure; unit diagnostics require an issue on a deliberately mismatched entries map, and the expected coordinate and operand units are separate entries. Round-trip equality checks the parser/renderer inverse contract.

assertion_review.assertions: operator count/kind/op/args, base, qualifiers, composition and round trip
assertion_review.fails_if: The operator is removed, coordinate binding changes, the operand is split incorrectly, or rendering loses canonical spelling.
The flat facade loses the fused coordinate or changes canonical rendering.

assertion_review.assertions: ParseError for missing or unregistered index
assertion_review.fails_if: The strict parser accepts an omitted index or banana as an index.
Any declaration differs from the independent required argmax schema.

assertion_review.assertions: reject bool and arbitrary dimension effects; default None
assertion_review.fails_if: The field reverts to boolean/unconstrained values or gives preserving operators a transformation.

assertion_review.assertions: matching dimensionless coordinate has no issues
assertion_review.fails_if: Correct index units trigger a mismatch or base-implies-unit warning.

assertion_review.assertions: one issue names result, coordinate, W, 1 and WARNING
assertion_review.fails_if: The index effect is operand or absent, unit comparison is bypassed, or diagnostic loses either independently stored unit or identity; the effect mutation produced this failure.

assertion_review.assertions: one missing-target warning names result and coordinate
assertion_review.fails_if: The absent-target branch is removed or the index effect is lost; both mutations fail this case.

assertion_review.assertions: invalid spelling defers to structural validation
assertion_review.fails_if: ParseError escapes or this semantic check invents an issue for structurally invalid input.

assertion_review.assertions: Wb coordinate with Wb result has no issues; outer square avoids inner-coordinate comparison
assertion_review.fails_if: Argmax is hard-coded as dimensionless or the validator compares the inner argmax coordinate against the square result unit.

assertion_review.assertions: complete literal set of 16 operand operators, each operand effect, strict parse and no warning
assertion_review.fails_if: Any prior transformation loses its exemption or typed registration, including fused indexed derivatives and postfix per_solid_angle.
A dimension-preserving flux-surface reduction is assigned a transformation or retains an obsolete boolean.
The solid-angle transformation is absent, index-derived or still boolean.
